rules.quote: Convert transactions from one AXI4 Manager into ordered APB4 transfers through one APB port.

rules.statement: The bridge uses one shared clock and has only one global transaction active at a time.

rules.quote: Included: AXI4 read/write channels; FIXED, INCR and WRAP bursts; 32-bit addresses/data; 1-, 2-, and 4-byte transfers; IDs; PSTRB; PPROT; error propagation and defensive request rejection. / Bao gồm: kênh đọc/ghi AXI4; burst FIXED, INCR, WRAP; địa chỉ/dữ liệu 32 bit; transfer 1, 2, 4 byte; ID; PSTRB; PPROT; truyền lỗi và từ chối request phòng vệ.

rules.statement: A product choice must not weaken a protocol requirement of the selected standards.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-FUNC-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall convert each accepted AXI transaction into ordered APB transfers and return its AXI completion. / Chuyển giao dịch AXI thành APB tuần tự và trả completion.; Source: REF-001/002; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Independent model simulation
rules.statement: The bridge shall convert each accepted AXI transaction into ordered APB transfers and return its AXI completion.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-FUNC-002; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall keep at most one global read or write transaction active. / Mỗi lúc chỉ một giao dịch đọc hoặc ghi hoạt động.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Assertions
rules.statement: The bridge shall keep at most one global read or write transaction active at any time.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-FUNC-003; Requirement using shall/should/may: When AR and AW are both pending, the bridge shall grant by round-robin, choose AR for the first tie after reset, and flip the next tie preference after each completed transaction. / Khi AR và AW cùng chờ, bridge phân xử round-robin, ưu tiên AR ở lần hòa đầu tiên sau reset và đổi ưu tiên sau mỗi giao dịch hoàn tất.; Source: Decision; WF-011; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Directed arbitration test
rules.condition: When AR and AW are both pending
rules.statement: The bridge shall arbitrate between AR and AW by round-robin.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-FUNC-003; Requirement using shall/should/may: When AR and AW are both pending, the bridge shall grant by round-robin, choose AR for the first tie after reset, and flip the next tie preference after each completed transaction. / Khi AR và AW cùng chờ, bridge phân xử round-robin, ưu tiên AR ở lần hòa đầu tiên sau reset và đổi ưu tiên sau mỗi giao dịch hoàn tất.; Source: Decision; WF-011; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Directed arbitration test
rules.statement: The bridge shall choose AR for the first tie after reset.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-FUNC-003; Requirement using shall/should/may: When AR and AW are both pending, the bridge shall grant by round-robin, choose AR for the first tie after reset, and flip the next tie preference after each completed transaction. / Khi AR và AW cùng chờ, bridge phân xử round-robin, ưu tiên AR ở lần hòa đầu tiên sau reset và đổi ưu tiên sau mỗi giao dịch hoàn tất.; Source: Decision; WF-011; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Directed arbitration test
rules.statement: The bridge shall flip the next tie preference between AR and AW after each completed transaction.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall accept an AXI transfer only when VALID and READY are high at rising ACLK. / Chỉ nhận AXI khi VALID và READY cao tại cạnh lên ACLK.; Source: REF-001 A3.1–A3.2; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: AXI checker
rules.statement: The bridge shall accept an AXI transfer only when VALID and READY are both high at rising ACLK.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-002; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall support FIXED (1–16 beats), INCR (1–256 beats), and WRAP (2/4/8/16 beats). / Hỗ trợ FIXED (1–16 beat), INCR (1–256 beat) và WRAP (2/4/8/16 beat).; Source: REF-001 A3.4; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Burst scoreboard

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-003; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall support AxSIZE 0/1/2 (1/2/4 bytes); reject unsupported size/burst and 4-KiB crossing without APB. / Hỗ trợ AxSIZE 0/1/2; từ chối size/burst không hỗ trợ và vượt 4 KiB, không truy cập APB.; Source: REF-001 A3.4; decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Negative tests
rules.statement: The bridge shall support AxSIZE values 0, 1 and 2 (1, 2, 4 bytes).

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-003; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall support AxSIZE 0/1/2 (1/2/4 bytes); reject unsupported size/burst and 4-KiB crossing without APB. / Hỗ trợ AxSIZE 0/1/2; từ chối size/burst không hỗ trợ và vượt 4 KiB, không truy cập APB.; Source: REF-001 A3.4; decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Negative tests
rules.statement: The bridge shall reject unsupported size/burst and 4-KiB-crossing transactions without any APB access.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-004; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall align APB PADDR down to four-byte word; copy WSTRB to PSTRB and drive PSTRB=0 on reads. / Căn PADDR xuống word 4 byte; chép WSTRB sang PSTRB, PSTRB=0 khi đọc.; Source: REF-002 §§2.1, 3.2; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: APB monitor
rules.statement: The bridge shall align APB PADDR down to a four-byte word boundary.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-004; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall align APB PADDR down to four-byte word; copy WSTRB to PSTRB and drive PSTRB=0 on reads. / Căn PADDR xuống word 4 byte; chép WSTRB sang PSTRB, PSTRB=0 khi đọc.; Source: REF-002 §§2.1, 3.2; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: APB monitor
rules.statement: The bridge shall copy WSTRB to PSTRB.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-004; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall align APB PADDR down to four-byte word; copy WSTRB to PSTRB and drive PSTRB=0 on reads. / Căn PADDR xuống word 4 byte; chép WSTRB sang PSTRB, PSTRB=0 khi đọc.; Source: REF-002 §§2.1, 3.2; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: APB monitor
rules.statement: The bridge shall drive PSTRB=0 on reads.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-005; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall echo ARID on every R beat and AWID on the corresponding B response. / Phản hồi ARID trên mọi beat R và AWID trên B tương ứng.; Source: REF-001 A5.1–A5.2; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: ID scoreboard
rules.statement: The bridge shall echo ARID on every R beat.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-005; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall echo ARID on every R beat and AWID on the corresponding B response. / Phản hồi ARID trên mọi beat R và AWID trên B tương ứng.; Source: REF-001 A5.1–A5.2; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: ID scoreboard
rules.statement: The bridge shall echo AWID on the corresponding B response.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-006; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall copy AxPROT to PPROT; omit AxLOCK, USER, QOS and REGION ports. / Chép AxPROT sang PPROT; bỏ các port AxLOCK, USER, QOS, REGION.; Source: REF-001 A4.7; REF-002 §3.5; decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Interface inspection
rules.statement: The bridge shall copy AxPROT to PPROT.

rules.statement: The bridge shall omit AxLOCK, USER, QOS and REGION ports.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-007; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall accept only AxCACHE 0000/0001; otherwise return SLVERR without PSEL. / Chỉ nhận AxCACHE 0000/0001; trường hợp khác trả SLVERR, không bật PSEL.; Source: REF-001 A4.3–A4.4; decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Attribute test

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-008; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall do not implement exclusive access; integration shall not send exclusive traffic. / Không triển khai exclusive; hệ thống không gửi exclusive traffic.; Source: REF-001 A7.2.3; decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Interface review
rules.statement: Integration shall not send exclusive traffic to the bridge.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-009; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall hold AXI VALID/payload through handshake and APB control/payload stable while PREADY=0. / Giữ ổn định VALID/payload AXI đến handshake và APB khi PREADY=0.; Source: REF-001 A3.2; REF-002 §3.1; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Protocol assertions
rules.statement: The bridge shall hold AXI VALID and payload stable through the handshake.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-IF-009; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall hold AXI VALID/payload through handshake and APB control/payload stable while PREADY=0. / Giữ ổn định VALID/payload AXI đến handshake và APB khi PREADY=0.; Source: REF-001 A3.2; REF-002 §3.1; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Protocol assertions
rules.statement: The bridge shall hold APB control and payload stable while PREADY=0.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-CLK-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall use one shared ACLK/PCLK domain; contain no asynchronous clock crossing. / Dùng chung ACLK/PCLK; không có CDC bất đồng bộ.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: CDC analysis

rules.quote: ID: REQ-RESET-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall use one active-low reset synchronous to ACLK; the SoC shall supply the reset synchronized to ACLK, and AXI VALID outputs shall be low while reset is sampled active. / Bridge dùng một reset active-low đồng bộ với ACLK; SoC phải cấp reset đã đồng bộ với ACLK và AXI VALID phải thấp khi reset được lấy mẫu ở mức active.; Source: REF-001 A3.1; decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Reset test

rules.statement: AXI VALID outputs shall be low while reset is sampled active.

rules.statement: PARA_AXI_ID_W shall set both read and write ID widths.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-ERR-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall unsupported reads return ARLEN+1 SLVERR beats, RLAST only on final beat, no APB. / Read không hỗ trợ trả ARLEN+1 beat SLVERR, RLAST ở beat cuối, không APB.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Negative read test
rules.statement: An unsupported read shall return ARLEN+1 R beats with SLVERR.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-ERR-001; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall unsupported reads return ARLEN+1 SLVERR beats, RLAST only on final beat, no APB. / Read không hỗ trợ trả ARLEN+1 beat SLVERR, RLAST ở beat cuối, không APB.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Negative read test

rules.quote: ID: REQ-ERR-003; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall unsupported writes drain AWLEN+1 W beats without APB, then return one SLVERR B. / Write không hỗ trợ nhận đủ AWLEN+1 beat W, không APB, rồi trả B SLVERR.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Negative write test
rules.statement: The bridge shall not perform APB access for an unsupported write.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-ERR-003; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall unsupported writes drain AWLEN+1 W beats without APB, then return one SLVERR B. / Write không hỗ trợ nhận đủ AWLEN+1 beat W, không APB, rồi trả B SLVERR.; Source: Decision; Applies to: CFG-BASE; Verification method: Negative write test
rules.statement: The bridge shall then return one SLVERR B response.

rules.quote: ID: REQ-ERR-004; Requirement using shall/should/may: The bridge shall external APB fabric provides default unmapped Completer with PREADY=1 and PSLVERR=1. / Fabric APB cung cấp Completer mặc định cho địa chỉ unmapped, PREADY=1, PSLVERR=1.; Source: Decision; Applies to: Integration; Verification method: Integration test
rules.statement: The external APB fabric shall provide a default unmapped Completer with PREADY=1 and PSLVERR=1.

rules.statement: The bridge shall hold the APB access while PREADY=0 and wait indefinitely if PREADY never rises.

rules.quote: Configuration ID: CFG-BASE; Enabled features: Full AXI4 Subordinate, APB4 Manager, legal FIXED/INCR/WRAP, ID echo; Disabled features: CDC, timeout, CSR, exclusive, USER/QOS/REGION; Interfaces / widths: AXI 32/32; APB 32/32; ID default 4; shared clock; Intended use: Peripheral transactions; Verification target: Protocol/function/error/boundary/backpressure
rules.statement: CFG-BASE shall use 32-bit AXI address/data and 32-bit APB address/data, default ID width 4, and a shared clock.

rules.quote: AXI ID width is elaboration-configurable.
rules.statement: The AXI ID width may be configured at elaboration.

rules.quote: The top contains only instances and port wiring. Top chỉ chứa instance và kết nối port.
rules.statement: The top module m_axi2apb_bridge contains only child instances and port wiring, with no other logic.

rules.quote: The read and write sequencers translate AXI transactions into internal APB requests. m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl combines round-robin AR/AW arbitration, transaction ownership, and the shared APB4 controller. Sequencer đọc/ghi chuyển AXI thành yêu cầu APB nội bộ. m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl gộp phân xử AR/AW round-robin, quản lý quyền sở hữu giao dịch và điều khiển APB4 dùng chung. RTL module: m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl; Responsibility: Arbitrate AR/AW round-robin, retain the transaction owner through final R/B, select read/write requests, and drive APB setup/access / Phân xử AR/AW round-robin, giữ quyền sở hữu đến R/B cuối, chọn yêu cầu đọc/ghi và điều khiển APB setup/access; Internal interface: AXI ARVALID/AWVALID; sequencer ready/done; gnt_rd/gnt_wr; rd_req/rd_rsp; wr_req/wr_rsp; APB4; Clock/reset domain: CLK-AXI / RST-AXI; State or storage: Arbitration turn, active owner, APB phase and payload
rules.condition: When both AR and AW requests are pending
rules.statement: m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl arbitrates between AR and AW requests in round-robin order.

rules.quote: AXI response backpressure stalls the owning sequencer. / Hierarchy RTL gồm một top cấu trúc và ba module con. Backpressure response AXI giữ sequencer đang sở hữu giao dịch.
rules.condition: When AXI response backpressure occurs (RREADY or BREADY low)
rules.statement: AXI response backpressure must stall the sequencer that owns the transaction.

rules.quote: RTL module: m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl; Responsibility: Arbitrate AR/AW round-robin, retain the transaction owner through final R/B, select read/write requests, and drive APB setup/access / Phân xử AR/AW round-robin, giữ quyền sở hữu đến R/B cuối, chọn yêu cầu đọc/ghi và điều khiển APB setup/access; Internal interface: AXI ARVALID/AWVALID; sequencer ready/done; gnt_rd/gnt_wr; rd_req/rd_rsp; wr_req/wr_rsp; APB4; Clock/reset domain: CLK-AXI / RST-AXI; State or storage: Arbitration turn, active owner, APB phase and payload
rules.condition: From grant until the final R or B response
rules.statement: m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl retains the transaction owner until the final R or B response completes.

rules.quote: Read: accept AR, validate, perform one APB read per beat in AXI order, then present RVALID/RDATA/RRESP/RLAST/RID and hold until RREADY. / Read: nhận AR, kiểm tra, thực hiện APB read mỗi beat theo thứ tự AXI, rồi đưa RVALID/RDATA/RRESP/RLAST/RID, giữ đến RREADY.
rules.statement: The bridge performs one APB read per beat in AXI order, then presents RVALID/RDATA/RRESP/RLAST/RID and holds them until RREADY.

rules.quote: Write: accept AW then W beats in order. Perform one APB write per beat; after the last APB completion, return B. / Write: nhận AW rồi W theo thứ tự. WVALID có thể đến trước AW nhưng WREADY thấp đến khi nhận AW.
rules.statement: The bridge accepts AW first and then W beats in order.

rules.quote: WVALID may precede AW but WREADY remains low until AW. WVALID có thể đến trước AW nhưng WREADY thấp đến khi nhận AW.
rules.statement: The master may assert WVALID before the AW address is accepted.

rules.quote: WVALID may precede AW but WREADY remains low until AW. WVALID có thể đến trước AW nhưng WREADY thấp đến khi nhận AW.
rules.statement: WREADY must remain low until AW has been accepted.

rules.quote: Perform one APB write per beat; after the last APB completion, return B. / Write: nhận AW rồi W theo thứ tự. Mỗi beat ghi APB; trả B sau APB cuối.
rules.condition: After the last APB write completion
rules.statement: The bridge performs one APB write per beat and returns B only after the last APB completion.

rules.quote: One transaction owns the bridge; reads and writes do not interleave.
rules.statement: Only one transaction owns the bridge at a time; read and write transactions must not interleave.

rules.quote: APB transfers are sequential; payload/control remain stable during wait.
rules.statement: APB transfers must be sequential.

rules.quote: APB transfers are sequential; payload/control remain stable during wait.
rules.statement: APB payload and control signals must remain stable during wait.

rules.quote: IDs are retained and echoed unchanged.
rules.statement: IDs are retained and echoed unchanged in the response (RID equals ARID, BID equals AWID).

rules.quote: Read count is ARLEN+1; legal write count is AWLEN+1.
rules.statement: The read beat count is ARLEN+1 and the legal write beat count is AWLEN+1.

rules.quote: AXI response payload remains stable while VALID=1 and READY=0.
rules.condition: While VALID=1 and READY=0 on an AXI response channel
rules.statement: AXI response payload must remain stable while VALID=1 and READY=0.

rules.quote: Interface ID: IF-001; Type and revision: AXI4, IHI 0022 H.c; Role: Subordinate; Direction at IP boundary: AXI Manager ↔ bridge; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Required / optional: Required; Configurations: CFG-BASE
rules.statement: The bridge must implement the required AXI4 (IHI 0022 H.c) Subordinate interface IF-001 on CLK-AXI in CFG-BASE.

rules.quote: Interface ID: IF-002; Type and revision: APB4, IHI 0024 D; Role: Manager/Requester; Direction at IP boundary: Bridge ↔ APB fabric; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; PCLK=ACLK; Required / optional: Required; Configurations: CFG-BASE
rules.statement: The bridge must implement the required APB4 (IHI 0024 D) Manager/Requester interface IF-002 on CLK-AXI with PCLK=ACLK in CFG-BASE.

rules.quote: APB setup uses PSEL=1/PENABLE=0; access uses PSEL=1/PENABLE=1 and completes at PREADY=1. / Input được lấy mẫu tại cạnh lên i_clk_axi khi handshake/điều kiện hoàn tất tương ứng. APB setup dùng PSEL=1/PENABLE=0; access dùng PSEL=1/PENABLE=1 và hoàn tất khi PREADY=1.
rules.statement: APB setup phase must have o_apb_psel=1 and o_apb_penable=0; access phase has both 1 and completes when i_apb_pready=1.

rules.quote: Port: o_axi_bid; Direction: Output; Width: PARA_AXI_ID_W; Meaning (function): Write response ID / ID response ghi; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (BVALID); Reset / idle value: 0 in reset; Timing / sampling: Stable to B handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE Port: o_axi_bresp; Direction: Output; Width: 2; Meaning (function): Write response status / Trạng thái B; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (BVALID); Reset / idle value: 0 in reset; Timing / sampling: Stable to B handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE
rules.statement: o_axi_bid and o_axi_bresp must remain stable until the B handshake completes.

rules.quote: Port: o_axi_bid; Direction: Output; Width: PARA_AXI_ID_W; Meaning (function): Write response ID / ID response ghi; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (BVALID); Reset / idle value: 0 in reset; Timing / sampling: Stable to B handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE Port: o_axi_bresp; Direction: Output; Width: 2; Meaning (function): Write response status / Trạng thái B; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (BVALID); Reset / idle value: 0 in reset; Timing / sampling: Stable to B handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE
rules.statement: o_axi_bid and o_axi_bresp must be 0 in reset.

rules.statement: o_axi_rid, o_axi_rdata and o_axi_rresp must remain stable until the R handshake completes.

rules.quote: Port: o_axi_rid; Direction: Output; Width: PARA_AXI_ID_W; Meaning (function): Read response ID / ID response đọc; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (RVALID); Reset / idle value: 0 in reset; Timing / sampling: Stable to R handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE Port: o_axi_rdata; Direction: Output; Width: 32; Meaning (function): Read beat data / Dữ liệu beat đọc; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (RVALID); Reset / idle value: 0 in reset; Timing / sampling: Stable to R handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE Port: o_axi_rresp; Direction: Output; Width: 2; Meaning (function): Read response status / Trạng thái R; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (RVALID); Reset / idle value: 0 in reset; Timing / sampling: Stable to R handshake; Configurations: CFG-BASE
rules.statement: o_axi_rid, o_axi_rdata and o_axi_rresp must be 0 in reset.

rules.quote: Port: o_axi_rlast; Direction: Output; Width: 1; Meaning (function): Final read beat marker / Đánh dấu beat cuối; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (RVALID); Reset / idle value: 0 in reset; Timing / sampling: High only on final beat; Configurations: CFG-BASE
rules.statement: o_axi_rlast must be high only on the final read beat.

rules.quote: Port: o_apb_paddr; Direction: Output; Width: 32; Meaning (function): Word-aligned byte address / Địa chỉ byte căn word; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (PSEL); Reset / idle value: 0 idle; Timing / sampling: Stable through transfer; Configurations: CFG-BASE Port: o_apb_pwrite; Direction: Output; Width: 1; Meaning (function): APB direction / Hướng đọc/ghi APB; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (PSEL); Reset / idle value: 0 idle; Timing / sampling: Stable through transfer; Configurations: CFG-BASE Port: o_apb_pprot; Direction: Output; Width: 3; Meaning (function): Copy of AxPROT / Bản sao AxPROT; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (PSEL); Reset / idle value: 0 idle; Timing / sampling: Stable through transfer; Configurations: CFG-BASE
rules.statement: o_apb_paddr, o_apb_pwrite and o_apb_pprot must remain stable through the transfer.

rules.quote: Port: o_apb_paddr; Direction: Output; Width: 32; Meaning (function): Word-aligned byte address / Địa chỉ byte căn word; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (PSEL); Reset / idle value: 0 idle; Timing / sampling: Stable through transfer; Configurations: CFG-BASE Port: o_apb_pwrite; Direction: Output; Width: 1; Meaning (function): APB direction / Hướng đọc/ghi APB; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (PSEL); Reset / idle value: 0 idle; Timing / sampling: Stable through transfer; Configurations: CFG-BASE Port: o_apb_pwdata; Direction: Output; Width: 32; Meaning (function): APB write data / Dữ liệu ghi APB; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (PSEL and PWRITE); Reset / idle value: 0 idle; Timing / sampling: Stable during wait; Configurations: CFG-BASE Port: o_apb_pstrb; Direction: Output; Width: 4; Meaning (function): APB byte strobes / Strobe byte APB; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (PSEL and PWRITE); Reset / idle value: 0 idle; zero on read; Timing / sampling: Stable through access; Configurations: CFG-BASE Port: o_apb_pprot; Direction: Output; Width: 3; Meaning (function): Copy of AxPROT / Bản sao AxPROT; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (PSEL); Reset / idle value: 0 idle; Timing / sampling: Stable through transfer; Configurations: CFG-BASE
rules.statement: o_apb_paddr, o_apb_pwrite, o_apb_pwdata, o_apb_pstrb and o_apb_pprot must be 0 when idle.

rules.quote: Port: o_apb_paddr; Direction: Output; Width: 32; Meaning (function): Word-aligned byte address / Địa chỉ byte căn word; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (PSEL); Reset / idle value: 0 idle; Timing / sampling: Stable through transfer; Configurations: CFG-BASE
rules.statement: o_apb_paddr must be a word-aligned byte address.

rules.quote: Port: o_apb_pwdata; Direction: Output; Width: 32; Meaning (function): APB write data / Dữ liệu ghi APB; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (PSEL and PWRITE); Reset / idle value: 0 idle; Timing / sampling: Stable during wait; Configurations: CFG-BASE
rules.condition: APB write transfer waiting for i_apb_pready
rules.statement: o_apb_pwdata must remain stable during wait states.

rules.statement: o_apb_pstrb must remain stable through the access.

rules.quote: Port: o_apb_pstrb; Direction: Output; Width: 4; Meaning (function): APB byte strobes / Strobe byte APB; Clock domain: CLK-AXI; Signal type: data (PSEL and PWRITE); Reset / idle value: 0 idle; zero on read; Timing / sampling: Stable through access; Configurations: CFG-BASE
rules.statement: o_apb_pstrb must be zero on reads.

rules.statement: o_apb_pprot must be a copy of the corresponding AxPROT.

rules.quote: Case: AXI read; Legal behavior: FIXED/INCR/WRAP, size 0–2, cache 0000/0001; Illegal / unsupported case: Unsupported request or 4-KiB crossing; IP response: No APB; ARLEN+1 R beats with SLVERR; Requirement IDs: REQ-IF-002/003/007, REQ-ERR-001
rules.condition: AXI read is legal: FIXED/INCR/WRAP, size 0-2, cache 0000/0001, no 4-KiB crossing
rules.statement: A legal AXI read (FIXED/INCR/WRAP, size 0–2, cache 0000/0001) must be supported and performed as APB transfers.

rules.quote: Case: AXI read; Legal behavior: FIXED/INCR/WRAP, size 0–2, cache 0000/0001; Illegal / unsupported case: Unsupported request or 4-KiB crossing; IP response: No APB; ARLEN+1 R beats with SLVERR; Requirement IDs: REQ-IF-002/003/007, REQ-ERR-001
rules.condition: AXI read request is unsupported or crosses a 4-KiB boundary
rules.statement: The bridge must issue no APB transfer and return ARLEN+1 R beats with RRESP SLVERR.

rules.quote: Case: AXI write; Legal behavior: AW followed by declared W beats; W may arrive early; Illegal / unsupported case: Unsupported AW request; AXI protocol violations are outside the guaranteed profile; IP response: No APB for unsupported AW; drain W, then SLVERR B; Requirement IDs: REQ-IF-002/003/007, REQ-ERR-003
rules.statement: A legal AXI write consists of an AW request followed by the declared number of W beats; W data may arrive before AW.

rules.quote: Case: AXI write; Legal behavior: AW followed by declared W beats; W may arrive early; Illegal / unsupported case: Unsupported AW request; AXI protocol violations are outside the guaranteed profile; IP response: No APB for unsupported AW; drain W, then SLVERR B; Requirement IDs: REQ-IF-002/003/007, REQ-ERR-003
rules.statement: W beats may arrive before the AW request.

rules.quote: Case: AXI write; Legal behavior: AW followed by declared W beats; W may arrive early; Illegal / unsupported case: Unsupported AW request; AXI protocol violations are outside the guaranteed profile; IP response: No APB for unsupported AW; drain W, then SLVERR B; Requirement IDs: REQ-IF-002/003/007, REQ-ERR-003
rules.statement: The bridge must issue no APB transfer, drain the W beats, then return a B response with SLVERR.

rules.quote: Case: AXI write; Legal behavior: AW followed by declared W beats; W may arrive early; Illegal / unsupported case: Unsupported AW request; AXI protocol violations are outside the guaranteed profile; IP response: No APB for unsupported AW; drain W, then SLVERR B; Requirement IDs: REQ-IF-002/003/007, REQ-ERR-003
rules.statement: AXI protocol violations are outside the guaranteed profile, so bridge behavior is not guaranteed for them.

rules.quote: Case: APB transfer; Legal behavior: One transfer per AXI beat; Illegal / unsupported case: PREADY never rises; IP response: Hold access; no timeout; Requirement IDs: REQ-IF-004, REQ-ERR-005
rules.statement: The bridge must perform one APB transfer per AXI beat.

rules.quote: Case: APB transfer; Legal behavior: One transfer per AXI beat; Illegal / unsupported case: PREADY never rises; IP response: Hold access; no timeout; Requirement IDs: REQ-IF-004, REQ-ERR-005
rules.condition: PREADY never rises during the access phase
rules.statement: The bridge must hold the APB access indefinitely and not time out.

rules.quote: Case: APB error; Legal behavior: PSLVERR sampled on completed transfer; Illegal / unsupported case: Read data on error is invalid per APB; IP response: Read beat SLVERR; write error accumulates; Requirement IDs: REQ-ERR-002/006
rules.statement: The bridge must sample PSLVERR on the completed APB transfer.

rules.quote: Case: APB error; Legal behavior: PSLVERR sampled on completed transfer; Illegal / unsupported case: Read data on error is invalid per APB; IP response: Read beat SLVERR; write error accumulates; Requirement IDs: REQ-ERR-002/006
rules.statement: The bridge must return the read beat with RRESP SLVERR, treating read data as invalid.

rules.quote: Case: APB error; Legal behavior: PSLVERR sampled on completed transfer; Illegal / unsupported case: Read data on error is invalid per APB; IP response: Read beat SLVERR; write error accumulates; Requirement IDs: REQ-ERR-002/006
rules.statement: The bridge must accumulate the write error and report it in BRESP.

rules.quote: Case: Unmapped address; Legal behavior: External default error Completer responds; Illegal / unsupported case: Missing default responder is integration violation; IP response: PREADY=1/PSLVERR=1, then AXI SLVERR; Requirement IDs: REQ-ERR-004
rules.statement: The external default Completer must respond with PREADY=1 and PSLVERR=1, and the bridge must then return AXI SLVERR.

rules.quote: Case: Unmapped address; Legal behavior: External default error Completer responds; Illegal / unsupported case: Missing default responder is integration violation; IP response: PREADY=1/PSLVERR=1, then AXI SLVERR; Requirement IDs: REQ-ERR-004
rules.statement: A missing default responder for unmapped addresses is an integration violation and must not occur.

rules.quote: AXI4 prohibits a burst from crossing a 4-KiB address boundary. This bridge defensively rejects such a request before issuing APB traffic. / AXI4 cấm burst vượt biên địa chỉ 4 KiB.
rules.condition: burst request crosses a 4-KiB address boundary
rules.statement: The bridge must reject the request before issuing any APB traffic.

rules.quote: AXI4 prohibits a burst from crossing a 4-KiB address boundary.
rules.statement: A burst must not cross a 4-KiB address boundary.

rules.quote: No interrupt port is in the approved baseline. Diagnostics/interrupt need remains open; see ASM-006. / Baseline không có interrupt.
rules.statement: The baseline bridge has no interrupt port.

rules.quote: The SoC must provide i_rst_n_axi synchronous to CLK-AXI. / Không có CDC hoặc synchronizer vì ACLK/PCLK dùng chung input. SoC phải cấp i_rst_n_axi đồng bộ với CLK-AXI.
rules.statement: The SoC must provide i_rst_n_axi synchronous to CLK-AXI (i_clk_axi).

rules.quote: Reset ID: RST-AXI; Port: i_rst_n_axi; Polarity / assertion: Active-low, synchronous assertion; Sync or async: Synchronous; Scope: AXI/APB control and state; Deassertion: SoC supplies reset synchronous to i_clk_axi; Reset value: AXI VALID=0; PSEL/PENABLE=0 after the active reset edge
rules.condition: After active reset edge of i_rst_n_axi
rules.statement: PSEL and PENABLE must be 0 after the active reset edge, and AXI VALID outputs must be 0 during reset.

rules.quote: Reset is sampled on the rising edge of i_clk_axi; keep it active for at least one rising edge. Reset cancels in-flight local state; completion/rollback of an interrupted transfer is not guaranteed. / Reset được lấy mẫu ở cạnh lên i_clk_axi; giữ reset active ít nhất một cạnh lên.
rules.statement: Reset is sampled on the rising edge of i_clk_axi, and i_rst_n_axi must be kept active for at least one rising edge.

rules.quote: The SoC owns reset synchronization and must coordinate the AXI Manager and APB fabric. SoC quản lý đồng bộ reset và phải phối hợp reset AXI Manager với APB fabric.
rules.statement: The SoC owns reset synchronization and must coordinate the reset of the AXI Manager with the APB fabric.

rules.quote: Reset cancels in-flight local state; completion/rollback of an interrupted transfer is not guaranteed. / Reset được lấy mẫu ở cạnh lên i_clk_axi; giữ reset active ít nhất một cạnh lên. Reset hủy state đang chạy; không đảm bảo hoàn tất/rollback transfer bị ngắt.
rules.condition: When reset is asserted during a transfer
rules.statement: Reset cancels in-flight local state; completion or rollback of an interrupted transfer is not guaranteed.

rules.quote: Declare PARA_AXI_ID_W as parameter logic [31:0], default 4.
rules.statement: PARA_AXI_ID_W must be declared as parameter logic [31:0] with default value 4.

rules.quote: Its three required comments immediately precede the declaration: Parameter Description, Parameter values, Parameter unit. / Khai báo PARA_AXI_ID_W dạng parameter logic [31:0], mặc định 4. Ba comment Parameter Description, Parameter values, Parameter unit đứng ngay trên khai báo. Required comment labels are Parameter Description, Parameter values and Parameter unit.
rules.statement: The comments Parameter Description, Parameter values and Parameter unit must immediately precede the PARA_AXI_ID_W declaration.

rules.quote: Parameter: PARA_AXI_ID_W; Purpose: AXI read/write ID width / Độ rộng ID AXI; Default: 4; Legal values / range: 1–16 inclusive; Dependencies / invalid combinations: Shared width; invalid value is elaboration error; Effect: Changes ID port widths
rules.condition: When PARA_AXI_ID_W is outside the legal range 1 to 16 inclusive
rules.statement: PARA_AXI_ID_W legal range is 1 to 16 inclusive; any invalid value must cause an elaboration error.

rules.quote: Parameter: PARA_AXI_ID_W; Purpose: AXI read/write ID width / Độ rộng ID AXI; Default: 4; Legal values / range: 1–16 inclusive; Dependencies / invalid combinations: Shared width; invalid value is elaboration error; Effect: Changes ID port widths
rules.statement: PARA_AXI_ID_W must set the width of the AXI read/write ID ports, shared between read and write.

rules.quote: Address/data/APB widths are fixed at 32 bits. / Nhãn comment bắt buộc là Parameter Description, Parameter values và Parameter unit. Độ rộng địa chỉ/dữ liệu/APB cố định 32 bit.
rules.statement: Address, data and APB widths must be fixed at 32 bits.

rules.quote: Configuration: CFG-BASE; Parameter overrides: PARA_AXI_ID_W=4; Features/interfaces: Section 4; Expected hierarchy: m_axi2apb_bridge with m_axi2apb_rd_seq, m_axi2apb_wr_seq, and m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl; Elaboration/lint/synthesis target: Check ID widths 1, 4, 16
rules.statement: CFG-BASE must elaborate with hierarchy m_axi2apb_bridge containing m_axi2apb_rd_seq, m_axi2apb_wr_seq and m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl, and ID widths 1, 4, 16 must pass elaboration, lint and synthesis checks.

rules.quote: Quantity: Address; Width: 32; Encoding / range: Unsigned byte address; Extension / truncation: APB PADDR clears bits [1:0]; Overflow / invalid behavior: Reject 4-KiB crossing
rules.statement: APB PADDR must clear address bits [1:0] of the 32-bit AXI byte address.

rules.quote: Quantity: Address; Width: 32; Encoding / range: Unsigned byte address; Extension / truncation: APB PADDR clears bits [1:0]; Overflow / invalid behavior: Reject 4-KiB crossing
rules.condition: A burst would cross a 4-KiB boundary
rules.statement: A burst that crosses a 4-KiB boundary must be rejected.

rules.quote: Quantity: AXI/APB data; Width: 32; Encoding / range: Four byte lanes; Extension / truncation: No lane rotation; Overflow / invalid behavior: Unsupported size → SLVERR
rules.statement: The 32-bit data path must not rotate byte lanes between AXI and APB.

rules.quote: Mode/state: REJECT_WRITE; Entry condition: Unsupported AW; Behavior: Drain W count; no APB; Exit condition: B handshake; Outputs / side effects: SLVERR
